name: Appium
summary: Cross-platform automation for native, hybrid and mobile web apps on iOS and Android through the WebDriver protocol.
strengths: One API for iOS and Android, from any WebDriver client language.
Tests the real app binary without modifying it.
Supported by all major device clouds.
tradeoffs: Slower than in-process frameworks such as Espresso or XCUITest.
Setup of drivers, simulators and signing takes real effort.
Needs careful synchronization to stay stable.
